episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Years after surviving a tragic incident that killed two others, Kieran returns home to Evelyn Bay. Soon after he arrives, a body turns up on the beach.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As they continue their investigation, the police uncover troubling details that create tension in the community, and cause some residents to panic.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As the investigation heats up, the police search for missing items that could prove crucial. Later, a break in the case leads to an arrest.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Kieran searches for evidence and sneaks into a neighbor's home with his friends. Later, he confesses an old secret to Mia.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Mia discovers new evidence, and learns of a past incident that might connect to the case – and raise troubling questions about the two men that died.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Old mysteries unravel as Kieran visits the caves to piece the clues together. Can Evelyn Bay finally put the past to rest?
